theme_and_archetype.domain: B2B Cybersecurity Consulting & EU NIS2 Compliance
theme_and_archetype.description: High-end corporate consultancy aesthetic combining deep blacks, crisp gold accents, and elegant typography to convey authority, bespoke service, and urgency. No neon, no purple, no generic SaaS blues.

rules.headings: Always use 'Cinzel'. Do not center align by default. Use normal or bold weight, never light.
rules.body: Always use 'Outfit'. Keep line height relaxed.
rules.overline: Use the micro-typography settings for all category tags and overlines.

usage.background_layers: Use the #050505 root background. Use #0c0c0c (or card var) for surface layers like cards and modals.
usage.primary_gold: Use #bf953f strictly for accents, primary buttons, micro-typography, and subtle borders.
usage.forbidden: Do NOT use purple (#9D4CDD) or teal (#1B93A4). Do NOT use generic gradients. No pure white backgrounds except for the marquee.

spacing_and_layout.alignment: Prioritize left-alignment for dense text and cards. Asymmetry is preferred over perfect centering.

header.links: Anchor links (Metodologia, Riscos, Testemunhos, FAQ, Contacto) visible on desktop.

hero.visual: Dark overlay background with the radar pulse effect.
hero.radar_effect: A series of concentric circles centered around a key visual or background, using absolute positioning, border-[#bf953f]/30, rounded-full, and animate-ping on the outer rings.
hero.ctas: Double CTAs. Primary: 'bg-white text-black hover:bg-black hover:text-white border border-white hover:border-white transition-all'. Secondary: 'bg-transparent text-[#bf953f] border border-[#bf953f]/50 hover:bg-[#bf953f]/10'.

marquee.implementation: Use react-fast-marquee. Content: Regulatory alerts ('PRAZO NIS2: OUTUBRO 2024 • COIMAS ATÉ 10M€ • AUDITORIA OBRIGATÓRIA...')

methodology_90_days.cards: 4 numbered cards. Glass-morphism (bg-white/5 border border-white/10 hover:border-[#bf953f]/40).
methodology_90_days.content: Numbers (01, 02...) in large Cinzel font (#bf953f). Titles: Gap Analysis, Plano de Resposta, Governance, Compliance.

risks.layout: 3 columns. Focus on text clarity and urgency.
risks.content: Cadeia de Fornecedores, Reporte em 24h, Responsabilidade Civil da Administração.

testimonials.style: Clean bento-style cards. Uses portraits from media_urls.
testimonials.content: Quotes from C-level / board members about the precision and necessity of Dalpin's audit.

faq.component: Shadcn Accordion. Background transparent, white text, subtle bottom borders border-white/20. Hover state text-[#bf953f].

lead_capture_form.backend: FastAPI to MongoDB + Resend email for Executive Checklist PDF.
lead_capture_form.ui: Shadcn form. Inputs: bg-transparent border-white/20 focus:border-[#bf953f] text-white. Placeholder text-white/40.
lead_capture_form.submit_button: Solid white button, black text, inverted on hover.

modal_priority_audit.trigger: Secondary Hero CTA or Nav CTA.
modal_priority_audit.style: Glass-morphism overlay. Dark card background border-[#bf953f]/30.
modal_priority_audit.content: Fake door list for Priority Audit. Simple form (Email) to join waitlist.

footer.layout: py-24 border-t border-white/10. 4 columns (Logo/About, Links, Legal, Contact).
footer.micro: Includes full address, copyright, and subtle gold accents.

microinteractions.hover_states: Buttons use inverted hover (white to black text/bg swap). Cards use subtle transform -translate-y-1 and a glow shadow shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(191,149,63,0.15)].
microinteractions.scroll_reveals: Use framer-motion for fade-in and slight slide-up (y: 20 -> 0) on scroll.
microinteractions.radar_pulse: Continuous slow ping animation on Hero background elements to simulate scanning/auditing.

hero_backgrounds.description: Abstract dark geometric pattern with golden accents for the hero background.
Golden metallic lines against black background, alternative for specific sections.

logos.description: EU Logo for compliance trust badge.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install Google Fonts for 'Cinzel' and 'Outfit' in index.html.
Install 'framer-motion' for scroll reveals and modal animations.
Install 'lucide-react' for all icons (CheckCircle, Shield, ChevronDown, ArrowRight, etc.).
Strictly follow the color palette. Dark backgrounds, gold accents (#bf953f), white text.
Implement the FastAPI backend for lead capture (saving to MongoDB) and use Resend for sending the PDF link.
Ensure all language used in the UI is Portuguese (pt-PT).
Add data-testid attributes to all form inputs, CTAs, modal triggers, and accordion items (e.g., data-testid='lead-form-email-input').

Use Shadcn UI for the Lead Form, Dialog (fake door), and Accordion (FAQ), but heavily override their default styles to match the dark/gold luxury theme (remove default white backgrounds, use bg-transparent and border-white/20).
Do NOT use pure white overlays on images. Max overlay opacity bg-black/50 to let the luxury textures shine through.
